manuscript_claim: Introduction gap: no controlled comparison under one zonal workload
evidence_at_cutoff: The study has a useful fixed-benchmark comparison across shaping policies, two burst alignments, multiple loads and receiver/image outcomes.
limitation: Migge/Navet and Maile already compare traffic-shaping mechanisms; the manuscript-wide statement is too broad.
editorial_action: Restrict to the specific ZB-3T workload, alignment design and image-completion outcomes; avoid a universal novelty claim.

manuscript_claim: C0 is sensitive to aligned camera bursts at L3
evidence_at_cutoff: C0 L3/A0: 30/30 viable; L3/A1: 0/30. In L3/A1, C0 reported 579,892 receiver packet losses, all attributed to CSW→HPC/TC4; F02 lost 219,747/6,750,000 packets and 219,565/225,000 images were incomplete.
limitation: Result applies to this benchmark/cell and the C0 software/replay caveat remains for C1 comparison.
editorial_action: Describe the observed alignment-associated failure boundary, not a universal alignment law.

manuscript_claim: C1 pre-shaping rescues L3/A1 image delivery
evidence_at_cutoff: C1 L3/A1: 30/30 viable, zero packet loss, all F02/F05 images complete; F02/F05 image p99 rises vs C0 L0/A0 by median +8.978/+14.134 ms.
limitation: C0/C1 binaries differ in traffic replay implementation; calendar signatures and F21/F22 populations match, but this is not a perfectly isolated causal contrast. Image p99 is conditional on complete images.
editorial_action: Present delivery/completeness and latency cost together.

manuscript_claim: C2 calibrated CBS extends viability vs nominal CBS
evidence_at_cutoff: Not identifiable in this paper matrix: nominal CBS is not an included treatment. The calibrated treatment (historic C3) passes 59/180 across L0–L2, with 0/120 at L0/L1 and 59/60 at L2.
limitation: No nominal-CBS comparator; low-load failures include both TC4 drops and TC6 deadline misses without loss.
editorial_action: Remove any superiority-over-nominal claim; report transfer behavior across offered-load cells.

manuscript_claim: C3 joint CBS/TAS has broad viability
evidence_at_cutoff: At cutoff, historic C4 has 90/90 passing, but only L0 is complete (60/60); L1 has 24/60 and L2 6/60. All 90 passed the included application/stability/sampled-sync checks.
limitation: L1/L2 are selected partial seed sets. C4-vs-C2 is a complete-policy contrast, not TAS-only. High-load performance is unknown.
editorial_action: Report as promising partial evidence, not broad validation.

evidence_at_cutoff: In paired L0/A0, C4 minus calibrated CBS (historic C3) brake packet p99 median is +57.594 µs F08, +57.996 µs F09 and +57.587 µs F10; C4 still meets 100 µs deadline, max observed 78.461 µs.
limitation: Policies also differ in reservations and gPTP; cannot attribute this effect only to TAS. No high-load C4 yet.
editorial_action: Do not claim improvement; report observed cost and remaining margin.

manuscript_claim: No single treatment dominates across all metrics/regimes
evidence_at_cutoff: C1 trades image completeness against longer completion tails; calibrated CBS fails at L0/L1 but passes almost all L2; C4 passes observed cells with brake-tail cost.
limitation: C4 partial and BE-specific trade-offs require full per-flow results; H5 not yet verified over full matrix.
editorial_action: State as a pattern compatible with the hypothesis, not a confirmed general result.

evidence_at_cutoff: C4 passed its sampled offset checks; continuous compliance is not verified. C0–C2 do not have directly comparable corrected clock records in these report metrics.
limitation: Sampling does not establish continuous conformance.
editorial_action: Use “passed sampled synchronization criterion”; explicitly mark continuous behavior not verified.
